A: Apical four-chamber echocardiogram of a neonate with functional pulmonary atresia with intact ventricular septum, showing right atrial and right ventricular enlargement with leftward displacement of the interventricular septum, indicative of right heart volume overload. panels.figure_caption: Echocardiographic features of functional pulmonary atresia demonstrating right heart enlargement and ductal-dependent pulmonary blood flow.
